title: Nepal operating hydropower point-reference crossmatch
purpose: Reproducible research layer linking the legacy/local NAXA hydropower point registry to official Department of Electricity Development operating-record matches without treating generic project points as powerhouse coordinates.

filter.coordinate: properties.raw_lat and properties.raw_lon must be finite, non-zero WGS84 values

coordinate_policy.map_coordinate: Use raw_lat/raw_lon from the local/NAXA project registry when available.
coordinate_policy.human_label: Published NAXA/local project reference point; not guaranteed powerhouse, dam, intake or headworks.
coordinate_policy.display_geometry_note: The external processed display geometry may be river-aligned for cartographic display. This research map deliberately uses the stored raw coordinates rather than silently substituting a snapped display point.

coverage_note: The 201-point subset is a pinned July 2026 DoED-NAXA/local crossmatch. The current September 2026 DoED operating authority contains 217 projects. The two counts use different snapshots and should not be treated as a claim that all September operating projects have been point-matched.

unmatched_official_context.midpoint_rule: DoED licence-envelope midpoints are not facility locations and are not promoted into the NAXA/local point-reference layer.

map_usage.failure_mode: If the pinned external GeoJSON cannot be loaded or does not return exactly 201 qualified operating point rows, the map shows a warning instead of silently claiming complete coverage.
